# Fine-tuned reranker (generated by `python -m app.eval.finetune score`; do not edit by hand)

Base `cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2`, fine-tuned on 700 (JD, CV) pairs of the v1 dev JDs only (2 epochs, lr 2e-05, batch 8, max 512 tokens, seed 0; no hyper-parameter search). Input: the JD's requirement queries vs the CV's evidence passages. CE0 is the untouched base model on the same input. Mean nDCG@10 with 95% bootstrap CI; paired one-sided bootstrap p for “first > second”. PYTHONHASHSEED=0.

## Test (v1, 10 JDs, official)

| System | JDs | nDCG@10 [95% CI] |
|---|---|---|
| CE0 (JD, evidence) | 10 | 0.709 [0.579, 0.836] |
| CE-ft (JD, evidence) | 10 | 0.730 [0.580, 0.864] |
| B3 8-axis ⊕ CE0 [hybrid] | 10 | 0.847 [0.767, 0.917] |
| B3 8-axis ⊕ CE-ft [hybrid] | 10 | 0.877 [0.802, 0.938] |
| B3 8-axis ⊕ CE [hybrid] | 10 | 0.831 [0.763, 0.893] |

| First | second | ΔnDCG@10 | p |
|---|---|---|---|
| CE-ft (JD, evidence) | CE0 (JD, evidence) | +0.022 | 0.311 |
| B3 8-axis ⊕ CE-ft [hybrid] | B3 8-axis ⊕ CE0 [hybrid] | +0.030 | 0.021 |
| B3 8-axis ⊕ CE-ft [hybrid] | B3 8-axis ⊕ CE [hybrid] | +0.046 | 0.003 |

## Test (v1, 10 JDs) over held-out CVs only: the CV-disjoint check (G5)

CE-ft⊥ was trained on 352 dev pairs whose CV is not held out; every system here is scored over the held-out half of each pool. CE-ft saw those CVs in training (under dev JDs), CE-ft⊥ did not.

| System | JDs | nDCG@10 [95% CI] |
